slides.texte_overlay:
small acts of detachment
that brought me peace

muting instead of arguing

i stopped arguing with strangers online and simply muted them instead. my mornings became so much quieter, and i didn't miss a single one of those fights.

changing what i feed my mind

i swapped some of my scrolling for one small lesson a day. giving my mind something calm and interesting made all the noise online feel far less important.
slides.texte_sophia:
changing what i feed my mind

i used to fill every quiet minute with scrolling. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a myth, and my mind feels calmer and much less reactive.

slides.texte_overlay:
letting people leave

when someone drifted away, i stopped chasing them with long messages. the right people stay without being begged, and that single thought quietly set me free.

not explaining myself

i stopped writing long explanations for choices that only affect me. a short and kind no is enough, and it saves hours of worrying about what people think.

leaving early

i started leaving parties and places the moment i felt drained. going home early is not rude, it's a quiet way of respecting your own energy and peace.
